reading: The sketch lays out an inventory-management page (left nav sidebar, 'Inventory' title, 4 stat cards, a stock table) and, on top of it, a frosted overlay with a modal dialog containing a camera-view tile, a found-item result row, and a quantity stepper (for scanning/adding stock). Typed notes give exact specs (sizes, colors, copy) for every part, which take priority over the rough ink shapes.
